Data Protection & GDPR

Privacy Policy

1. Data Controller

The data controller responsible for the processing of personal data on this website and in the studio is:

Custom Ink Luxembourg
103, Waistrooss · L-5440 Remerschen · Luxembourg
Email: info@customink.lu · Telephone: +352 26 55 07 66
(Official RCS company registration details available upon direct request at the studio premises).

2. How We Collect and Process Enquiries

Our website is architected with privacy by default. When you submit the consultation enquiry form on this website:

  • No personal data is saved to a third-party server database or storage bucket by the website application.
  • Submitting the form formats your details into an email draft addressed directly to info@customink.lu.
  • No data is transmitted across the network until you review and confirm the email in your mail client.
  • The data requested (name, email, phone, project concept, placement, and size) is processed pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (taking steps prior to entering into a service contract) solely to evaluate your tattoo request and respond to your enquiry.

3. Cookies and Analytics

We believe in respectful browsing:

  • Essential Storage: We store only your selected preferences (such as your cookie consent choice) in your browser’s local storage.
  • Measurement & Analytics: Google Analytics 4 is strictly optional. It is never loaded unless you explicitly click “Accept all” or opt in via our Cookie Preferences dialog. When disabled or rejected, zero analytical cookies or tracking requests are fired.
  • You can review or modify your consent choice at any time using the Cookie Preferences link in the website footer.

4. Third-Party Integrations

To provide location maps and direct messaging channels, our website includes links to trusted external providers:

  • OpenStreetMap / Leaflet: Map tiles are loaded to display our Remerschen studio location. Your IP address is processed technically to serve map images.
  • WhatsApp & Social Links: Clicking our WhatsApp or social buttons directs you to Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. services under their respective privacy policies.

5. Data Retention

Direct email communications regarding consultation requests are retained for the duration needed to coordinate your project. If you proceed with a tattoo session, consultation records, consent forms, and invoice documentation are retained in accordance with statutory accounting and public health requirements in Luxembourg.

6. Your Rights Under GDPR

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (EU 2016/679), you hold the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • The right to request access to your personal data (Article 15).
  • The right to rectification of inaccurate personal data (Article 16).
  • The right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”) where applicable (Article 17).
  • The right to restriction of processing (Article 18).
  • The right to object to processing (Article 21).
  • The right to data portability (Article 20).

To exercise any of these rights, contact us directly at info@customink.lu.

7. Supervisory Authority

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority in Luxembourg:

Commission Nationale pour la Protection des Données (CNPD)
15, Boulevard du Jazz · L-4370 Belvaux · Luxembourg
Website: cnpd.public.lu
